name: VideoVault Photoshop Extension
releaseNotes:
- Activity telemetry no longer needs the VideoVault panel to be open. It now starts the moment Photoshop launches, the same way the Premiere Pro extension already works, so your work keeps showing up in VideoVault even if you never open the panel.
- If you do keep the panel open, you may occasionally see one extra activity entry for the same moment of work. This does not affect anything you do in Photoshop.
